observations: Many blue metal drums stacked outdoors/in a yard.
Each drum has a bung opening on the top and a side/edge opening/port visible on some drums.
No readable brand/model, no labels, and no clear markings on the drum faces.
Some drums show surface wear/staining; condition is not fully clear from photos.

claims.claim: Can be used for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Photos show generic blue metal drums but do not show liner material, prior contents, certification, or compatibility info.

risks.risk: Unknown prior contents/contamination (drums may have held chemicals/oil/solvents), affecting safety and suitability for 'any kind of liquid'.
risks.proof: Request photos of the drum labels/markings (if any) and ask for a statement of last contents + whether drums were rinsed/cleaned; ideally provide a cleaning certificate or inspection report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used drums with unknown prior contents (assume not suitable for food/drink and treat as lower value).

risks.risk: Liner/coating condition and internal rust/pitting (photos only show exterior; leaks or corrosion may exist inside).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the inside (open bung/top view) and the bottom seams; also ask for a leak test or whether any drums are leaking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing reconditioning and with leak risk (worst case: treat as not guaranteed leak-proof).

risks.risk: Capacity/size not confirmed (e.g., 50L/100L/200L), which strongly affects price.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the drum capacity marking or a tape-measure shot (height and diameter) on one drum.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely capacity tier until size is confirmed.

risks.risk: Quantity and whether all drums are the same type/condition (photos show many, but exact count and uniformity are unclear).
risks.proof: Ask for the exact number of drums available and photos of a representative sample showing condition across the batch.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming mixed condition within the batch.

proof_requests: Exact drum capacity (photo of markings or measured height/diameter).
Photos of the inside of at least 2–3 drums (open bung/top view) and bottom seams.
Last contents + whether drums were cleaned/rinsed (and any cleaning/inspection document if available).
Exact quantity available and a representative condition photo set (best/average/worst).
response.reason: The photos confirm generic used blue metal liquid drums, but key pricing drivers are missing: capacity, internal condition/leak risk, and prior contents/compatibility. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
